Broker androidId returns a persisted 16-hex source/profile installation pseudonym, stable across account/revision changes and distinct after source/profile/app-data changes. It does not disclose the global system Android ID; external authentication requiring that literal upstream identifier is not claimed compatible. Neither identifier grants execution authority.
